title: Add Graceful Shutdown & Health‑Check Endpoint
description: Introduce a /health route that returns service status and implement graceful shutdown handling for SIGINT/SIGTERM. This ensures orchestrators can reliably detect health and that the server drains in‑flight requests before exiting, reducing dropped requests in production.
testCases: Health endpoint returns 200 with {status:"ok"} JSON payload
Server stops accepting new connections after SIGTERM but finishes pending requests before exiting
Shutdown logs contain "Graceful shutdown initiated" and "Shutdown complete" messages
acceptance:
- GET /health returns 200 and correct JSON body
- After sending SIGTERM, server no longer accepts new connections but resolves all active requests before process exit
- Logs show start and completion of shutdown with timestamps
reason: Provides essential observability for container orchestration and prevents request loss during deployments, directly addressing production stability goals.
